(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {listWorkPackets,readWorkEvents}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/workPacketStore.ts');const s=useStudio.getState();const p=(await listWorkPackets(s.job.id))[0];const events=p?await readWorkEvents(p.id):[];return {pane:s.pane,packet:{id:p?.id,state:p?.state,nextAction:p?.nextAction,pendingAction:p?.pendingAction},events:events.filter(e=>e.kind==='tool-result'||e.kind==='model-response-unreviewed').map(e=>({kind:e.kind,payload:e.kind==='model-response-unreviewed'?{parts:e.payload.content.parts.filter(p=>!p.thought).map(p=>({text:p.text,call:p.functionCall}))}:{tool:e.payload.tool,result:e.payload.result.content.filter(c=>c.type==="text").map(c=>c.text.slice(0,1600)),isError:e.payload.result.isError}})),conversation:document.querySelector('[aria-label="Assistant conversation"]')?.innerText}})()
